scripts.dev: npm run build -w @linkvault/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @linkvault/api" "npm run dev -w @linkvault/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @linkvault/shared && npm run build -w @linkvault/api && npm run build -w @linkvault/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @linkvault/shared && npm run typecheck -w @linkvault/api && npm run typecheck -w @linkvault/web
